hooks.name: Typecheck and tests when the agent stops
hooks.description: The agent's last word is checked by a real run: typecheck, then the unit and property tests.

action.command: .kiro/hooks/scripts/log-fire.sh Stop typecheck+test; (npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E 'Test Files|Tests ') 2>&1 | tail -4 | tee -a docs/kiro-evidence/hook-fires.log
